commit_message: Add ADR0126 Project Rust Timeline control
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the ADR0126 Project Rust boundary through the existing ABI v3 architecture. Project systems can control logical Timeline players through a targetless deferred Timeline command family, inspect copied stable player state through a Timeline host view, and consume bounded Timeline marker/Event-track records through a dedicated event stream. Runtime handles and mutable players remain host-owned; u64 logical IDs/generations cross JSON as decimal strings, while stable Timeline asset/document IDs and exact canonical ticks remain copied values.

The command processor preserves callback atomicity with complete preflight and a virtual logical-player set. Project seeks suppress gameplay/irreversible event preview by construction. Regression tests cover command ordering, unknown players, copied host state, source identity, and duplicate event capture.

The PR remains Draft while Sequencer and final Windows/Visual Validation continue.
